name: s2-stageA2
comment: S2 STAGE A2 — the CORE LMR REDUCTION SHAPE, which stage A does not touch and which is plausibly the single biggest tuning lever in the engine. Stage A took the freshly transplanted S0 terms (RED_TTPV_*, RED_CUTOFFCNT_*, RED_ALLNODE_NUM) plus the eval-scale-coupled margins. But the reduction SHAPE underneath them — the log table's slope (RED_TABLE_NUM, REDUCTION_BASE/DEN_COEFF), the flat rebases (RED_BASE, RED_FLAT) and the node-type surcharges (RED_CUTNODE, RED_TTMOVE_SUB, RED_STATSCORE_NUM) — is still Stockfish's eca43a97 values, carried in at P9 and never tuned against OUR eval, which has been replaced twice since. SF re-tunes exactly these after every eval change. 12 params keeps the per-parameter SNR at stage-A level rather than diluting it across 41.
ordering_note: Run this BEFORE the broad stage B. It is the same size as stage A, so it gets the same signal per parameter, and it covers a larger Elo pool. The 41-param stage B is a coarse joint pass and should come last, warm-started from A and A2.
